text:
Pia: Morning - semver sabotage again? My tea forecast looks bleak.
Noah: Found `version: '1.0.0-beta'` shoved into prod.yaml like a secret admirer. YAML is feelings, not versions. :grimacing:
Riley: Earlier someone wrote `version: 1..0` and the parser threw a tantrum. Build failed. :boom:
InfraBot: [automated] build #721 failed: YAML syntax error at prod.yaml:8
Pia: Proposal: 'Semver Amnesty' week — every offender gifts donuts.
Noah: Or we add a pre-commit hook that enforces semver regex: ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ — no shenanigans.
Riley: I vote donut tax + hook. No one can resist carbs.
Pia: Bonus: anyone who mentions 'one-dot-oh' in commit messages owes a pun and a pastry.
Noah: I'll write the hook. If it scares me, I'll bake.
InfraBot: [automated] deploy succeeded on retry. Semver court adjourned. :gavel:
